## Description

Provide a clear, descriptive summary of the changes introduced by this pull request. Explain the problem being solved or the feature being added.

## Related Issues

Closes # (issue number)

## Type of Change

Please tick the relevant options:

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update (non-breaking change to docs)

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have added/updated documentation matching my changes.
- [ ] I have added unit or integration tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes.
- [ ] My changes generate no new TypeScript or lint errors.
